correctness.rationale: The source's disease-free equilibrium gives the exact susceptible fraction \(c(p+M_0)/[\lambda M_0+c(p+M_0)]\). Multiplying by the no-media reproduction number yields the printed \(\mathcal R_1\). Differentiation proves strict decrease in \(M_0\), its limit is \(\mathcal R_0c/(\lambda+c)\), and elementary rearrangement gives the if-and-only-if reachability condition and unique finite crossing. Exact rational replay reproduces the source's rounded Table 1 reproduction numbers and the new threshold values.

value.rationale: The source makes \((\lambda,M_0)\) a central intervention plane and uses \(\mathcal R_1<1\) as the disease-free threshold. The accepted theorem converts its contour plot into a complete analytic phase boundary and reveals a qualitative distinction the plot alone does not expose: below a sharp dissemination rate, no amount of baseline advertising can cross the threshold because awareness transfer saturates. For the source parameters it also quantifies why \(M_0=500\) remains supercritical and gives the exact baseline or dissemination level needed to cross.
